clean_local_wheel_install.command:
rm -rf /tmp/ilc-0412-local-test && .venv/bin/python -m venv /tmp/ilc-0412-local-test && /tmp/ilc-0412-local-test/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip && cd /tmp && /tmp/ilc-0412-local-test/bin/pip install --quiet /Users/jamison/Documents/ILC_Main/01_Current/dist/ilc_core-0.4.12-py3-none-any.whl && /tmp/ilc-0412-local-test/bin/python - <<'PY'
import ilc_core
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric import mldsa
from ilc_core.crypto.pq_signature_verify import _MLDSA_PK_HEX_LENGTH, _MLDSA_SIG_HEX_LENGTH, verify_mldsa65_signature
from ilc_core.network.relay.relay_client import RELAY_CLIENT_NOT_ACTIVATED
from ilc_core.network.relay.relay_server import RELAY_SERVER_NOT_ACTIVATED, RelayUdpPortForwarder
from ilc_core.sidecars.connectivity_advertisement import CONNECTIVITY_ADVERTISEMENT_NOT_ACTIVATED
sk = mldsa.MLDSA65PrivateKey.generate()
pk = sk.public_key()
msg = b'ilc-0412-clean-wheel-mldsa-smoke'
sig = sk.sign(msg)
print('version', ilc_core.__version__)
print('relay_client_guard', RELAY_CLIENT_NOT_ACTIVATED)
print('relay_server_guard', RELAY_SERVER_NOT_ACTIVATED)
print('connectivity_ad_guard', CONNECTIVITY_ADVERTISEMENT_NOT_ACTIVATED)
print('mldsa_pk_hex_length', _MLDSA_PK_HEX_LENGTH)
print('mldsa_sig_hex_length', _MLDSA_SIG_HEX_LENGTH)
print('cryptography_mldsa_verify', verify_mldsa65_signature(msg, sig.hex(), pk.public_bytes_raw().hex()))
print('cryptography_mldsa_wrong_message', verify_mldsa65_signature(b'tampered', sig.hex(), pk.public_bytes_raw().hex()))
print('oqs_installed', end=' ')
try:
    import oqs  # type: ignore
except ModuleNotFoundError:
    print(False)
else:
    print(True)
print('forwarder_has_target_addr', '_target_addr' in RelayUdpPortForwarder.__init__.__code__.co_names)
